newsitem.title: USA: U.S. BLUE CHIPS EXTEND LOSSES, NYSE SETS CURBS.
newsitem.headline: U.S. BLUE CHIPS EXTEND LOSSES, NYSE SETS CURBS.

text.p: Wall Street stocks turned broadly lower, as a jittery bond market turned lower in afternoon activity and dragged the Dow industrials to more than 50 points in losses.

The Dow was down 55 points at 8007, triggering New York Stock Exchange program trading curbs at 1438 EDT/1838 GMT. The Nasdaq Composite also succumbed to the selling pressure, slipping to a fractional loss at 1587.
The benchmark 30-year U.S. Treasury slipped back from its early gains to stand 5/32 lower, yielding 6.65 percent.
Declining issues pulled nearly even with advancers on the NYSE, where volume remained active, pushing past the 400 million share level.
